description: Source code for input event processing in Android environment, including key and pointer event translation to Starboard input events, handling joystick and DPad inputs, and synthesizing events for disambiguation.

classes.name: InputEventsGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for converting Android input events into Starboard input events, handling joystick, key, and pointer inputs, and event synthesis.

methods.name: CreateInputEventsFromGameActivityEvent
methods.description: Main method to create Starboard input events from Android game activity events, handling key and joystick events.

methods.name: ProcessPointerEvent
methods.description: Processes Android pointer (touch/mouse) events into Starboard input events.

methods.name: ProcessJoyStickEvent
methods.description: Processes joystick axis movements into Starboard input events.

methods.name: CreateInputEventsFromSbKey
methods.description: Creates press and unpress events for a given Starboard key.

methods.name: ProcessFallbackDPadEvent
methods.description: Handles disambiguation between DPad and thumbstick events for fallback keys.

methods.name: UpdateHatValuesAndPossiblySynthesizeKeyEvents
methods.description: Updates hat axis values and generates corresponding key events if values change.

methods.name: UpdateDeviceFlatMapIfNecessary
methods.description: Caches device axis flatness values for joystick input processing.
